fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so responders arriving under low-visibility conditions can locate it without delay.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive so responders can move between the road and the main residence without obstruction.
• Thin dense vegetation near the main residence so responders can reach and move around the exterior walls.
• Thin dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can approach and work around all sides of that building.
• Clear a path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings without pushing through vegetation.
• Keep the patio area clear of stored items so responders can use it as a staging area.
• Trim any shrubs or low branches along the walkway so responders carrying equipment can move without obstruction.
• Because there is only one vehicle access point, avoid parking in a way that blocks the driveway so responding units can reach the residence and turn around.
• Keep the open lawn area free of parked vehicles and stored equipment so it remains available for responder staging.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees in the clusters closest to the structure to create more open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove low-hanging branches from large trees near the structure to reduce the path fire can take from the ground up into the tree canopy.
• Trim shrubs and plants growing directly against or touching the structure on all sides.
• Pull back vegetation on the sides of the structure where plants are growing closest to the walls.
• Thin or remove shrubs and smaller plants growing beneath large trees near the structure to reduce the amount of burnable material at ground level.
• Trim overhanging branches and cut back shrubs along the driveway edges to keep the travel lane clear for vehicles.
• Keep the area under and around driveway-side vegetation clear of dead leaves, fallen branches, and other dry material.
• Maintain the open green space areas by keeping grass mowed short, especially where it connects to tree clusters near the structure.
• Separate tree clusters from one another where they are close together and near the structure by removing trees or large shrubs between them.
• Remove dead branches, fallen limbs, and dry plant debris from beneath trees surrounding the structure.
